Draft ready for staff review
Purpose and background: Professional services procurement for bridge inspection and design support; proposals include exceptions and insurance notes.
Scope of work and deliverables.
Minimum qualifications and submission requirements.
Evaluation criteria and scoring process.
Required terms, insurance, records, and public-procurement disclosures.
Tentative schedule and award-approval path.

CivicProcure provides procurement-support drafts only. Staff own every decision; the module does not evaluate vendors, award contracts, provide legal advice, submit procurements, or replace the procurement system of record.
